name: WRC Predictions
summary: Stage-time forecasts for the FIA World Rally Championship.
description: Scaffolded on the shared MotorsportVerse core with working seams: a snapshot-backed DataSource implementing the core calendar/grid/results contract, a leakage-guarded prior-form Predictor, and a contract test suite asserting that nothing is fabricated while no feed is wired. Rallying diverges further from the template than any other series here — cumulative stage times rather than a race, an ordered road-position penalty, and points from more than the final classification. See the project README.
